item.title: Man jailed for non-recent sex offences against teenage girl
item.description: A man has been jailed for seven years and two months after he pleaded guilty to non-recent sex offences against a teenage girl. Tom Heckley, 25, of Muirfield Way in Woodhall Spa was convicted of 15 offences when he appeared at Lincoln Crown Court earlier today (22 January). item.title: Person hit by train west of Grantham
item.description: A person has been hit by a train between Nottingham and Grantham, with emergency services at the scene of the incident. Services are set to be disrupted for several hours. East Midlands Railway (EMR) first reported the incident at 12.15pm on Sunday (January 25).
